Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionThe story follows Ignat, a lonely young man surviving in a dark, dangerous post-apocalyptic cyberpunk world. After a tragic military conflict, the few remaining survivors had to adapt to a harsh new reality. Having lost his parents, Ignat has learned to live alone and build his life in this unforgiving environment. However, his once-stable existence changes dramatically when he receives an unexpected email message… “Hail to the Rainbow” is a first-person, story-driven adventure with horror and shooter elements. Set in a richly detailed world, the game challenges you to survive in a new reality, uncover the secrets behind the surrounding chaos, and experience the protagonist’s memories and inner struggles. Explore the environment, examine electronic records, solve technical puzzles, collect items, and upgrade your inventory - all of which will be essential for your journey. Features: - A new game from solo developer Sergey Noskov, creator of “In rays of the Light”, “35MM”, and “7th Sector” - A deep story and immersive world - Spectacular cyberpunk set in a post-apocalyptic Russia - Logical technical challenges and intense combat encounters with enemies - Bonus content after completing the game - Photo mode - Atmospheric soundtrack by Nobody's Nail MachineShow morePublished bySometimes YouDeveloped byNoskov SergeyRelease date10/21/2026Play withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SPCHandheldCapabilities4K Ultra HDSingle player60 fps+Optimized for Xbox Series X|SSmart DeliveryXbox achievementsXbox presenceXbox cloud savesXbox Play Anywhere XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Fantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesGamesMinecraft: DELUXE COLLECTIONReleases 10/27/26VersionNintendo Switch 2Select an editionDigital - Minecraft: DELUXE COLLECTIONFantasy ViolenceUsers Interact, In-Game PurchasesLoadingCreate, explore and survive alone or with friends CREATE. EXPLORE. SURVIVE. Build anything you can imagine, uncover mysteries, and face thrilling foes in an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. There’s no wrong way to play! Jump in with the DELUXE COLLECTION including: Three add-ons: Celebration Food, Rescue Dogs, and Plenty O’ Blocks; 3 exclusive Character Creator items; and 700 Minecoins*. VIBRANT VISUALS**Vibrant Visuals is Minecraft’s biggest official visual enhancement – delivering a dazzling cosmetic upgrade with a new modern graphics pipeline and an array of visual improvements. Sunrises are more vivid, water reflects, forests become shaded, and more!INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACKExplore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals** enabled! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario™ series.CreateBuild anything you can imagine in the ultimate sandbox game. Explore Uncover the mysteries of an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough.SurviveTake on challenging foes, thrilling landscapes and perilous dimensions. PLAY TOGETHER***Have a blast with friends, whether you’re sitting on the same couch in split screen or miles apart in cross-platform play. Connect with millions of players on community servers or join your own private server with up to 10 friends with Realms Plus. EXPERIENCE MORECreator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics are available on the Minecraft Marketplace. Marketplace Pass (or Realms Plus) includes 150+ worlds, skin & textures packs, and more – refreshed monthly. Nintendo Switch™ 2 Features:VIBRANT VISUALS** - Dig into your Minecraft adventure on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system with Vibrant Visuals support and embark on a journey across a world with enhanced lighting and shadow effects. Enjoy Vibrant Visuals enabled content across Minecraft Marketplace.CARRY OVER DATA FROM THE Nintendo Switch™ VERSION - Nintendo Switch™ worlds can be carried over, so you can pick up right where you left off.INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACK - Explore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled!*Included Minecoins and any Minecoins purchased in Minecraft on a Nintendo device must be used in the Nintendo ecosystem. **Vibrant Visuals not available in some gameplay, including split-screen and when using certain Marketplace Worlds and content. ***Cross-platform play requires Microsoft Account. Online multiplayer functionality requires a Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately).Software description provided by the publisher.Bundle includes the following:For details on the products in this bundle, including up-to-date system compatibility information, please refer to each product page listed below.MinecraftGamesMINECRAFT: DELUXE COLLECTION DLCGamesPublisher notification(s):Already own a digital version of Minecraft for Nintendo Switch™?
